# Clinical Pillars & Surgical Procedures Overview

## Facelift, Neck Lift & Brow Lift in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Deep-Plane Rhytidectomy, Corset Platysmaplasty & Endoscopic Brow Elevation
* **Clinical Category:** Facial Rejuvenation
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/facelift-surgery-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Restore natural, youthful contours with zero skin tension, concealed micro-incisions, and 10 to 15-year anatomical longevity.

### Procedure Overview
Facial aging occurs deep beneath the surface. Over time, facial retaining ligaments relax, allowing cheek fat pads to descend into jowls and loose neck bands. Pulling only the skin creates an artificial, tight appearance that relapses quickly.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Dr. Gujarathi operates beneath the deep muscular SMAS layer, releasing tethered retaining ligaments to naturally elevate the deeper facial foundation vertically back to its youthful position. Because deep structures support the lift, the surface skin drapes naturally under zero tension.

## Gynecomastia Surgery (Male Chest Reduction) in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Subareolar Gland Excision with High-Definition VASER Liposuction & Chest Sculpting
* **Clinical Category:** Male Aesthetics
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/gynecomastia-surgery-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Permanent, athletic male chest contouring combining precision glandular excision with ultrasound-assisted VASER sculpting and hidden micro-incisions.

### Procedure Overview
Gynecomastia is commonly known as enlarged male breasts or "man boobs". It happens when a firm breast gland and stubborn fat build up behind the nipples due to natural hormonal changes. Because this glandular tissue is firm and fibrous, it cannot be burned off by dieting, gym workouts, or heavy chest presses.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Dr. Chintan Gujarathi permanently removes this firm gland and sculpts the chest using gentle ultrasound (VASER) and tiny micro-incisions hidden along the natural dark edge of the nipple—giving you a flat, athletic masculine chest with virtually invisible scars.

## Rhinoplasty (Nose Reshaping Surgery) in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Aesthetic & Functional Open/Closed Septorhinoplasty with Cartilage Grafting
* **Clinical Category:** Facial Aesthetics
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/rhinoplasty-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Refining nasal proportions, smoothing dorsal humps, and correcting septal deviations for natural facial harmony and effortless breathing.

### Procedure Overview
Rhinoplasty, commonly known as a "nose job", is surgery to reshape the nose for better facial balance or to fix chronic breathing trouble. Whether you want to smooth out a prominent bridge hump, refine a wide or drooping tip, or straighten a crooked nose, the goal is always a natural result that looks native to your face.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Dr. Chintan Gujarathi performs both cosmetic reshaping and functional septoplasty together. Using your own natural cartilage rather than artificial implants, he reshapes the nasal bones and cartilage framework with micro-incisions—improving your breathing and facial harmony for life.

## Liposuction 360° & Body Contouring in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** High-Definition VASER Ultrasonic & Power-Assisted Liposuction (PAL)
* **Clinical Category:** Body Sculpting
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/liposuction-surgery-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Precision 360-degree body contouring using advanced VASER ultrasonic technology to eliminate stubborn fat and reveal athletic muscle definition.

### Procedure Overview
Diet and gym workouts shrink overall fat cells, but genetics determine where stubborn localized fat deposits remain trapped. Liposuction is not a weight loss tool—it is an artful body sculpting procedure designed to permanently eliminate targeted fat cells and highlight your underlying muscular contours.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Dr. Chintan Gujarathi utilizes third-generation VASER ultrasonic technology. Ultrasound probes emit high-frequency acoustic waves that selectively emulsify fat deposits while preserving critical nerves, blood vessels, and fibrous connective tissues. Liquefied fat is then gently aspirated using fine atraumatic micro-cannulas.

## Abdominoplasty (Tummy Tuck) & Body Contouring in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Full & Mini Abdominoplasty with Rectus Muscle Plication (Diastasis Recti Repair) & Neo-Umbilicoplasty
* **Clinical Category:** Body Contouring
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/tummy-tuck-abdominoplasty-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Restore a flat, firm abdominal wall and sculpted waistline with anatomical diastasis recti muscle repair, excess skin removal, and concealed bikini-line incisions.

### Procedure Overview
Pregnancy, significant weight fluctuations, and natural aging often stretch the abdominal skin envelope and weaken the underlying abdominal muscles (rectus abdominis), causing a persistent bulging belly or hanging apron of skin that no amount of diet or core exercise can flatten.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Dr. Chintan Gujarathi performs comprehensive abdominoplasty by tightening the separated rectus abdominal muscles back to the midline (internal muscle corset plication), removing redundant sagging skin and fat, and meticulously crafting a youthful, natural belly button (neo-umbilicoplasty)—all through an ultra-low incision hidden discreetly within the natural bikini line.

## Blepharoplasty (Eyelid Surgery & Bag Removal) in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Upper Blepharoplasty, Lower Transconjunctival Fat Transposition & Canthopexy
* **Clinical Category:** Facial Aesthetics
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/blepharoplasty-eyelid-surgery-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Eliminate heavy hooded upper eyelids and puffy under-eye bags with micro-incisions hidden in natural eyelid creases for bright, awake, and refreshed eyes.

### Procedure Overview
Tired, heavy-looking eyes often have nothing to do with lack of sleep or aging prematurely. Over time, delicate eyelid skin stretches, and natural protective fat pads behind the eyes begin to push forward, causing drooping upper eyelids and prominent lower eye bags. Blepharoplasty (eyelid lift surgery) gently removes this excess skin and smooths bulging fat to restore a bright, rested, and youthful gaze.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Dr. Chintan Gujarathi performs upper blepharoplasty through a micro-incision tucked invisibly within your natural eyelid crease. For lower eyelids, he utilizes an internal (transconjunctival) technique placed entirely inside the lower eyelid with zero external skin cuts. Rather than simply removing fat and causing a hollow look, he smooths and repositions the fat across the orbital rim into the tear trough depression, creating a smooth transition from lower lid to cheek.

## Cancer Reconstructive Surgery (Microvascular Free Flaps) in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Microvascular Free Tissue Transfer (ALT, DIEP Autologous Breast & Free Fibula Mandibular Reconstruction)
* **Clinical Category:** Microsurgery & Reconstruction
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/cancer-reconstructive-surgery-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Super-specialized microvascular tissue transfer restoring speech, swallowing, facial form, and natural breast contour following oncological resections.

### Procedure Overview
Surgical removal of head, neck, oral, or breast cancers often leaves complex structural and functional defects that significantly impact appearance, speech, chewing, swallowing, and quality of life. Modern reconstructive microsurgery allows plastic surgeons to transplant living tissue from one part of the body to another, restoring form and vital function.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Dr. Chintan Gujarathi completed his super-specialized Oncoplastic & Microvascular Fellowship at the prestigious Tata Memorial Hospital, Mumbai. Using high-magnification surgical operating microscopes, he reconnects microscopic arteries and veins (1–2 mm in diameter) using micro-sutures finer than human hair to ensure uninterrupted blood circulation in the transplanted tissue.

## Burn Surgeries & Acute Burn Care in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Acute Burn Resuscitation, Tangential Excision, Split-Thickness Skin Grafting (STSG) & Contracture Release
* **Clinical Category:** Burn Care & Reconstruction
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/burn-treatment-scar-surgery-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Comprehensive critical burn management from emergency acute resuscitation and tangential skin grafting to complex post-burn scar contracture release and joint restoration.

### Procedure Overview
Thermal, electrical, and chemical burn injuries cause severe damage to the skin barrier and underlying soft tissues, often resulting in critical fluid loss, infection risks, and disabling post-burn scars. Timely, specialized surgical intervention is essential to save lives, preserve limb function, and minimize lifelong scarring.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Dr. Chintan Gujarathi manages both acute burns and late-stage burn deformities. In acute cases, necrotic devitalized skin is excised (tangential excision) and covered with autologous split-thickness skin grafts (STSG) harvested with automated dermatomes. In chronic cases, tight, restrictive scar bands (contractures) across the neck, axilla, elbows, and fingers are surgically released and resurfaced with local Z-plasties or regional flaps to restore full joint mobility.

## Trauma Plastic Surgery & Defect Repair in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Emergency Soft Tissue Coverage, Local/Regional Fasciocutaneous Flaps & Microvascular Limb Salvage
* **Clinical Category:** Trauma & Limb Salvage
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/trauma-plastic-surgery-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Advanced emergency reconstruction for high-energy road traffic accidents, industrial crush injuries, and complex open fracture soft-tissue coverage with limb salvage.

### Procedure Overview
High-energy road traffic accidents (RTA), industrial machinery trauma, and severe crush injuries often cause extensive skin and soft-tissue loss, exposing vital bones, joints, tendons, and neurovascular bundles. Without prompt, expert plastic surgery flap coverage, exposed bone quickly develops osteomyelitis, often leading to tragic limb loss.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Dr. Chintan Gujarathi specializes in orthoplastic limb salvage—working closely with orthopedic and trauma teams. He provides well-vascularized tissue coverage using local muscle flaps (such as Gastrocnemius for upper tibia, Soleus for middle tibia), regional perforator flaps (propeller flaps), or free microvascular tissue transfer (ALT/LD flaps) to seal the wound and ensure rapid bone union.

## Hand Surgery & Carpal Tunnel Release in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Microsurgical Carpal Tunnel Release, Flexor/Extensor Tendon Repair & Complex Hand Reconstruction
* **Clinical Category:** Hand & Peripheral Nerve
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/hand-surgery-carpal-tunnel-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Super-specialized microsurgical hand surgery restoring tactile sensation, grip strength, and delicate digit dexterity for nerve compressions, traumatic cuts, and chronic hand disorders.

### Procedure Overview
The human hand represents an extraordinary convergence of delicate tendons, intricate nerve branches, and microvascular arcades that enable both fine pinch precision and powerful grasp. When injury, repetitive strain, or compression strikes the hand, surgical intervention demands the highest level of microsurgical finesse. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi brings subspecialty plastic surgery expertise to treat everything from nocturnal carpal tunnel numbness to critical tendon lacerations and complex post-traumatic deformities.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Surgical management requires navigating the narrow carpal tunnel bordered by the carpal bones and transverse carpal ligament, protecting the recurrent motor branch of the median nerve and digital sensory nerves. In acute cuts, Zones I through V flexor tendon repairs must provide high tensile strength while maintaining a frictionless profile that glides effortlessly beneath the fibro-osseous pulley system (A2 and A4 pulleys) without snapping or jamming.

## Facial Bone Fracture Fixation in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Open Reduction & Rigid Internal Fixation (ORIF) with Titanium Mini-Plates & Occlusal Restoration
* **Clinical Category:** Maxillofacial & Craniofacial
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/facial-bone-fracture-treatment-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Advanced rigid internal fixation restoring anatomical facial symmetry, normal dental bite occlusion, and natural orbital volume following road accidents, sports trauma, and physical impacts.

### Procedure Overview
Facial fractures caused by road accidents, falls, or sports injuries represent both a delicate aesthetic challenge and a functional emergency. Fractures of the lower jaw (mandible), upper jaw (maxilla), cheekbone (zygoma), and eye socket (orbit) can disrupt chewing bite, cause double vision, and alter facial projection. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi combines plastic surgery aesthetics with maxillofacial biomechanics to reconstruct facial bone architecture using concealed incisions and micro-thin titanium implants.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Facial bone repair relies on re-establishing the structural vertical and horizontal buttresses of the facial skeleton. Fixation along Champy’s ideal lines of osteosynthesis ensures the natural distribution of masticatory forces across the jaw, while 3-point alignment of the zygomaticomaxillary complex (ZMC) restores true midface projection. In orbital fractures, releasing trapped rectus eye muscles and reconstructing the thin orbital floor with contoured mesh eliminates diplopia and prevents sunken eye appearance.

## Chronic Wound Care & Diabetic Foot Ulcer Treatment in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Surgical Debridement, Negative-Pressure Wound Therapy (NPWT/VAC) & Vascularized Flap Coverage
* **Clinical Category:** Wound Care & Limb Salvage
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/diabetic-foot-wound-care-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Comprehensive advanced wound management combining bio-burden debridement, negative-pressure VAC therapy, and vascularized reconstructive flaps to heal chronic diabetic foot ulcers, bedsores, and complex non-healing wounds.

### Procedure Overview
Chronic, non-healing wounds—including diabetic foot ulcers, sacral pressure sores (bedsores), venous stasis ulcers, and non-healing surgical breakdowns—impose an immense physical and emotional burden on patients and their families. Without aggressive specialized plastic surgery intervention, minor ulcers can progress to deep osteomyelitis, systemic sepsis, and avoidable limb amputations. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi offers advanced wound bed preparation, negative-pressure technology, and vascularized flap coverage to achieve durable, permanent healing.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Chronic wounds are characterized by high concentrations of inflammatory proteases (MMPs), resistant bacterial biofilms, and cellular senescence. In diabetic feet, sensorimotor neuropathy causes unperceived mechanical trauma over bony metatarsal heads, while microvascular ischemia starves the tissue of oxygen. Bedsores over the sacrum, ischium, and greater trochanter result from prolonged capillary ischemia exceeding 32 mmHg, causing tissue necrosis from the deep bone interface outward.

## AV Fistula Creation for Dialysis in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Microsurgical Arteriovenous Fistula Creation (Radiocephalic, Brachiocephalic & Basilic Transposition)
* **Clinical Category:** Vascular Access & Dialysis
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/av-fistula-surgery-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Precision microsurgical vascular access connecting native artery and vein to create a durable, high-flow, low-infection hemodialysis lifeline for patients with end-stage renal disease (ESRD).

### Procedure Overview
For patients diagnosed with chronic kidney disease (CKD) or end-stage renal disease (ESRD), creating a secure, reliable vascular access is literally establishing a lifeline for life-sustaining hemodialysis. A native arteriovenous (AV) fistula—created by surgically joining a high-pressure artery to an adjacent superficial vein—is universally acknowledged by nephrologists as the safest, longest-lasting form of vascular access. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi utilizes super-specialized microsurgical techniques to fashion resilient AV fistulas with exceptionally high primary patency rates.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Successful AV fistula surgery requires precise pre-operative vascular mapping. The high-pressure arterial inflow (radial artery at the wrist or brachial artery at the elbow) is anastomosed end-to-side to a suitable outflow vein (cephalic or basilic vein). High arterial shear stress triggers vein "arterialization"—the vein wall thickens and dilates to over 6 mm in diameter, allowing repeated cannulation with two large-bore dialysis needles three times a week without collapsing.

## Cosmetic Suturing of Facial Cuts & Lacerations in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Emergency Microsurgical Layered Closure, Subdermal Tension-Free Suturing & Scar Minimization
* **Clinical Category:** Emergency Facial Aesthetics
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/facial-cut-scarless-suturing-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Immediate precision facial suturing utilizing ultra-fine 6-0/7-0 micro-sutures and buried tension-relieving deep stitches to ensure seamless, virtually invisible scar outcomes.

### Procedure Overview
An accidental facial cut—whether from a road mishap, sports collision, broken glass, or a child’s fall at home—requires immediate specialized plastic surgery attention. When sutured with coarse hospital casualty stitches, facial cuts frequently heal with wide, depressed scars and unsightly cross-hatch "railroad track" marks. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi utilizes emergency microsurgical techniques to reconstruct anatomical tissue layers with microscopic precision, ensuring the scar heals as a hairline, barely noticeable mark.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Facial aesthetic closure relies on matching the relaxed skin tension lines (Langer’s lines) of the face. By utilizing deep absorbable dermal sutures (5-0 Monocryl) that bear 100% of underlying wound tension, the outer epidermal edges can be brought together without any strangulating tension. Special anatomical attention is paid to free margins—such as the lip vermilion border, eyelid gray line, and nasal alar rim—where even a 0.5 mm mismatch creates a permanent visible step deformity.

## Torn Ear Lobule Repair & Otoplasty in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Aesthetic Split Earlobe Repair, Piercing Hole Revision & Corrective Otoplasty (Ear Pinning)
* **Clinical Category:** Ear Aesthetics & Otoplasty
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/torn-earlobe-repair-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Painless in-office repair of torn, stretched, or split earlobes and corrective otoplasty for prominent bat ears, restoring natural lobule contours with immediate re-piercing options.

### Procedure Overview
Torn earlobes—resulting from wearing heavy traditional earrings, accidental snagging by children or clothing, or prolonged earring stretch—are one of the most common ear concerns among women in India. An elongated slit or complete split makes wearing earrings impossible and creates cosmetic distress. Additionally, congenital ear deformities such as prominent protruding "bat ears" can cause significant social self-consciousness. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi offers painless in-office reconstructive procedures that restore smooth, youthful ear architecture.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
The earlobe (lobule) consists of delicate fibro-fatty stroma enclosed in soft skin, lacking cartilage. Simple straight-line stitching frequently results in a tell-tale notch or indented cleft at the bottom rim due to scar contracture. Dr. Gujarathi utilizes specialized mini-flaps or Z-plasties at the inferior rim that break the contracture line, preserving a plump, naturally curved lobe. In otoplasty for prominent ears, permanent Mustardé and Furnas sutures re-create the missing antihelical fold and set back the deep conchal bowl.

## Pediatric Plastic Surgery & Cleft Care in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Cleft Lip Cheiloplasty, Cleft Palate Palatoplasty & Congenital Anomaly Reconstruction
* **Clinical Category:** Pediatric Plastic Surgery
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/pediatric-plastic-surgery-cleft-lip-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Super-specialized pediatric reconstructive surgery restoring anatomical facial symmetry, normal speech, feeding development, and congenital anomaly correction with gentle child-focused care.

### Procedure Overview
Cleft lip, cleft palate, and congenital hand or ear anomalies present unique challenges that affect an infant’s feeding, facial appearance, dental development, and future speech. Caring for these little patients requires not only surgical mastery of delicate pediatric anatomy but also compassionate, family-centered guidance. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi brings comprehensive pediatric reconstructive training to restore balanced facial symmetry and clear, intelligible speech.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
In cleft lip, the continuous ring of the orbicularis oris muscle is disrupted, with abnormal insertions anchoring into the base of the nose and causing flattening of the nasal wing. Cleft palate involves separation of the levator veli palatini muscles, which are crucial for lifting the soft palate against the back of the throat during speech. Without reconstruction, air escapes through the nose, leading to hypernasal speech and feeding difficulties.

## Scar Revision & Keloid Treatment in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Advanced Surgical Scar Revision, Geometric Broken-Line Z-Plasty & Multimodal Keloid Protocol
* **Clinical Category:** Scar Revision & Keloids
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/scar-revision-keloid-treatment-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Transformative surgical and multimodal scar revision re-orienting unsightly scars along natural facial skin tension lines, releasing tight contractures, and permanently flattening resistant keloids.

### Procedure Overview
Visible scars from prior accidents, emergency surgeries, burns, or severe acne can serve as a constant, unwanted reminder of past trauma. While no surgeon can make a scar vanish entirely, plastic surgery possesses extraordinary techniques to transform wide, thickened, or depressed scars into soft, hairline marks that blend imperceptibly into natural skin folds. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi combines micro-surgical excision, geometrical realignment, and multimodal keloid therapies to restore skin confidence.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Scars widen and thicken when their orientation runs perpendicular to the relaxed skin tension lines (RSTL) of the body, where mechanical movement repeatedly stretches the wound edges. By performing a Z-plasty or W-plasty, the scar vector is broken into small, irregular segments and redirected parallel to natural wrinkle lines. For keloids—which invade normal surrounding skin with excessive Type I collagen—surgical excision alone carries an 80% recurrence rate, making multi-modal combination therapy essential.

## Nail Bed Injuries & Fingertip Repair in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Perionychial Microsurgical Reconstruction, Matrix Repair & Local Flap Phalanx Coverage
* **Clinical Category:** Hand & Nail Surgery
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/nail-bed-fingertip-repair-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Sub-millimeter microsurgical restoration preserving sterile matrix adherence, fingertip pulp tactile sensation, and anatomical nail regrowth without split-nail deformities.

### Procedure Overview
Fingertips and nail beds are delicate, highly innervated sensory organs essential for fine pinch, object manipulation, and digit protection. Crush injuries from car doors, heavy machinery, or sports frequently cause severe subungual hematomas, complex nail bed lacerations, or fingertip pulp amputations. Improper initial treatment leads to chronic nail deformities like split nails, pterygium, hooked nails, or painful hypersensitive fingertips. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi utilizes operating loupe magnification and 7-0 micro-sutures to meticulously realign the germinal and sterile matrices, anatomical nail splints to maintain the eponychial fold, and local neurovascular advancement flaps (Atasoy / Kutler) to preserve finger length, natural contour, and discriminative sensation.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
The perionychium consists of the germinal matrix (producing 90% of the nail plate), sterile matrix (responsible for flat nail adherence), eponychium, paronychium (lateral nail folds), and hyponychium. Directly beneath the sterile matrix lies the distal phalanx (P3) bone and its richly vascularized pulp packed with sensory Meissner and Pacinian corpuscles. Any step-off deformity in the nail bed creates permanent nail ridging. Dr. Gujarathi anatomically realigns the lacerated matrix edges over the reduced P3 fracture, ensuring an airtight, smooth healing bed.

## Excision of Cysts, Lipomas, Ganglions & Warts in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Capsule Enucleation, Minimal-Incision Lipoma Extraction & Wrist Ganglion Stalk Excision
* **Clinical Category:** Outpatient Dermatosurgery
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/cyst-lipoma-ganglion-excision-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Scar-minimizing day-care surgical excision guaranteeing complete capsule and stalk removal to eliminate recurrence with invisible cosmetic intradermal closure.

### Procedure Overview
Benign subcutaneous lumps such as sebaceous (epidermoid) cysts, lipomas, wrist ganglions, and viral warts are extremely common. While non-cancerous, they cause physical discomfort, nerve compression, cosmetic distress, and risk painful secondary infections. Standard surgical excision often leaves conspicuous, uneven railroad-track scars, or results in recurrence because cyst sac remnants or ganglion stalks are left behind. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi applies plastic surgery principles to outpatient lesion removal: micro-incisions strategically concealed within natural skin crease lines (Langer’s lines), meticulous microscopic enucleation of the entire intact capsule or joint stalk, and multi-layered tension-free subcuticular suturing for an imperceptible cosmetic outcome.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Each lesion has distinct anatomical characteristics. Epidermoid cysts originate from follicular infundibulum and possess a thin, fragile epithelial lining containing keratin; leaving even a microscopic fragment guarantees recurrence. Lipomas are encapsulated, lobulated benign tumors of mature adipocytes situated in the subcutaneous layer, often adjacent to cutaneous nerves. Wrist ganglions are mucin-filled pseudocysts arising from the scapholunate joint capsule or tendon sheath, connected via a tortuous stalk. Complete eradication requires tracking the stalk down to its capsular origin without injuring the radial artery or median nerve.

## Dimple Creation, Buccal Fat & Tongue Tie in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Intraoral Dimpleplasty, Bichat Buccal Fat Pad Extraction & Lingual Frenuloplasty
* **Clinical Category:** Facial Aesthetics
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/buccal-fat-dimple-creation-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Scarless intraoral facial sculpting — bespoke dynamic dimple creation, chiselled cheek contouring via buccal fat removal, and laser-precise frenuloplasty.

### Procedure Overview
Subtle facial nuances make an immense aesthetic and functional difference. Dynamic cheek dimples convey warmth, youth, and charm, while excess buccal fat can create a heavy, overly rounded "baby face" that conceals cheekbone definition. Additionally, restrictive lingual frenulums (tongue-tie or ankyloglossia) impair speech articulation, feeding, and oral hygiene. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi offers specialized intraoral minor plastic surgery procedures performed entirely through invisible transoral access. Whether fashioning natural dynamic dimples that appear only when you smile, conservatively teasing out the buccal fat pad for sub-malar contouring, or performing delicate frenuloplasty, every procedure is executed with meticulous anatomical precision and zero external facial scarring.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
The intraoral anatomy requires precise surgical mastery. Buccal fat pads (Bichat’s fat pads) are encapsulated adipose structures situated in the midface beneath the buccinator muscle. During buccal fat extraction, the parotid (Stensen’s) duct and buccal branches of the facial nerve run closely adjacent; Dr. Gujarathi utilizes microscopic dissection to protect these structures while conservatively delivering 2 to 4 cc of fat. In dimpleplasty, an absorbable transoral suture hitches the deep dermis to the buccinator muscle fibers, creating a physiological tether that pulls inward dynamically when the muscle contracts during a smile. For tongue-tie, lingual frenuloplasty releases the fibrous cord between the ventral tongue and floor of the mouth, followed by transverse mucosal closure.

## Botox & Dermal Fillers (Anti-Aging Treatments) in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Neuromodulator Chemodenervation & Cross-Linked Hyaluronic Acid Dermal Volumization
* **Clinical Category:** Non-Surgical Aesthetics
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/anti-aging-botox-fillers-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Physician-administered anti-aging artistry — smoothing dynamic forehead lines, crow’s feet, and frown lines while restoring midface volume and jawline definition.

### Procedure Overview
Facial aging is a three-dimensional process characterized by dynamic repetitive muscular contractions that etch deep forehead wrinkles, crow’s feet, and frown lines, combined with profound loss of structural bone and deep fat pad volume leading to sunken tear troughs, sagging cheeks, hollow temples, and prominent nasolabial folds. Non-surgical facial rejuvenation restores youth without surgery when performed by an expert plastic surgeon with deep anatomical knowledge. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi delivers artistic, subtle, and natural anti-aging treatments using US-FDA approved neuromodulators (Allergan Botox) and cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal fillers (Juvederm, Restylane). Using micro-droplet dosing and blunt micro-cannula techniques, facial wrinkles are smoothed and youthful structural contours restored while strictly preserving natural, expressive facial mobility.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Safety and natural results depend on intimate knowledge of the 5 facial layers and vascular anatomy. The facial artery, angular artery, and infraorbital neurovascular bundles run in specific planes where inadvertent intravascular injection could cause skin necrosis. Dr. Gujarathi utilizes blunt-tipped micro-cannulas for midface, tear trough, and nasolabial filling, which gently push blood vessels aside rather than puncturing them. Neuromodulator micro-dosing targets the hyperdynamic frontalis, procerus, corrugator supercilii, and orbicularis oculi muscles at precise millimetric depths, blocking acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction without causing brow ptosis or a frozen mask.

## Arm Lift (Brachioplasty) & Thigh Lift in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Medial Brachioplasty & Medial Thighplasty with Deep Colles’ Fascial Suspension

* **Clinical Focus:** Reshape loose, hanging upper arm "batwings" and inner thigh skin folds with concealed incisions, lymphatic-sparing VASER debulking, and deep fascial suspension.

### Procedure Overview
Substantial weight loss (following bariatric surgery, diet, and lifestyle changes) or natural genetic aging frequently leaves patients with loose, hanging skin that no amount of gym training or diet can resolve. Hanging upper arm skin folds ("batwings") and rubbing inner thigh tissue cause persistent skin irritation, painful chafing during walking, and deep clothing dissatisfaction. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi performs advanced medial brachioplasty and thighplasty utilizing lymphatic-sparing techniques. By combining high-definition VASER liposuction with precise anatomical skin resection and anchoring deep tissues to the superficial fascial system and Colles’ fascia, the arms and thighs are restored to sleek, firm, athletic proportions with scars strategically placed in natural shadow lines.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Surgical contouring of the extremities demands strict respect for neurovascular and lymphatic structures. In the upper arm, the medial antebrachial cutaneous nerve and basilic vein run close to the medial bicipital groove; Dr. Gujarathi performs careful superficial dissection above the deep muscular fascia, preserving sensory branches and major lymphatic drainage to prevent chronic arm lymphedema. In the medial thigh, the great saphenous vein and femoral triangle lymphatics are safeguarded by keeping dissection in the superficial adipose plane. To prevent widening or downward migration of the groin scar, the deep dermal flap is anchored with permanent non-absorbable sutures to Colles’ fascia (ischiopubic periosteal fascia).

## Genital Rejuvenation (Labiaplasty & Hymenoplasty) in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Aesthetic Wedge Labiaplasty, Clitoral Hood Prepuce Reduction & Reconstructive Hymenoplasty

### Procedure Overview
Female intimate concerns are extremely common yet often endured in silence. Enlarged, asymmetrical, or protruding labia minora cause physical discomfort, chafing, and pain during cycling, running, or intercourse, as well as self-consciousness in tight swimwear or intimate settings. Similarly, hymenal reconstruction (hymenoplasty) is sought for personal, cultural, or restorative reasons. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi provides compassionate, ethical, and strictly confidential surgical care. Utilizing fine plastic surgery instrumentation and microsurgical principles, labiaplasty and hymenoplasty are performed in a sterile hospital day-care setting, restoring natural aesthetics, symmetry, and comfort while meticulously safeguarding sensitive nerve pathways and erogenous sensation.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Intimate surgical aesthetics requires delicate anatomical mastery. The labia minora possess a rich sensory innervation derived from the pudendal nerve, and their free edge has unique natural pigmentation and scalloped texture. Crude amputation ("trimming") cuts away this natural edge, risking scalloping deformities and sensory neuromas. Dr. Gujarathi performs the central V-wedge resection technique, which excises a pie-shaped wedge of excess tissue and rotates the natural, sensate pigmented edge back together. When clitoral hooding contributes to unbalance, a tailored lateral prepuce reduction is performed while strictly avoiding the midline dorsal nerve of the clitoris. For hymenoplasty, native mucosal remnants are de-epithelialized and re-approximated in two layers with fine 6-0 absorbable sutures to restore a flexible, vascularized ring.

## Nerve & Muscle Biopsies & Nerve Surgery in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Diagnostic Sural Nerve & Skeletal Muscle Biopsy, Schwannoma Enucleation & Microsurgical Epineural Grafting
* **Clinical Category:** Peripheral Nerve Surgery
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/peripheral-nerve-surgery-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Operating microscope precision for neuro-diagnostic biopsies, benign nerve sheath tumor enucleation without functional deficit, and microsurgical nerve reconstruction.

### Procedure Overview
Peripheral nerves are the body’s delicate biological wiring, transmitting motor commands to muscles and carrying sensory feedback from the skin. Peripheral nerve disorders—ranging from unexplained neuropathies and myopathies requiring diagnostic biopsy, to painful nerve sheath tumors (schwannomas and neurofibromas) and traumatic nerve lacerations—require super-specialized microsurgical expertise. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi utilizes operating loupes and high-power operating microscopes to perform delicate nerve procedures. Whether harvesting diagnostic sural nerve and muscle biopsies following strict neurologist protocols, intracapsularly enucleating schwannomas while preserving adjacent functional nerve fibers, or performing tension-free 9-0/10-0 epineurial nerve grafting, patient neurological function and comfort remain paramount.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
A peripheral nerve consists of individual axon fibers bundled within endoneurium, grouped into fascicles surrounded by perineurium, and sheathed externally by tough epineurium. When performing a diagnostic sural nerve biopsy behind the lateral malleolus, only a small segment of pure sensory nerve is harvested without affecting leg or foot motor strength. For muscle biopsies, fascicular architecture of the vastus lateralis or deltoid is preserved without crush artifact. In benign schwannomas, the tumor originates eccentrically from Schwann cells within a single non-functioning fascicle; operating under 10x-20x magnification allows the surgeon to identify the capsule, gently peel functional fascicles away, and shell out the tumor with zero motor or sensory deficit.

## Mommy Makeover Surgery in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Post-Pregnancy Comprehensive Abdominoplasty, Breast Rejuvenation & VASER 360° Liposculpting
* **Clinical Category:** Maternal Restoration
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/mommy-makeover-surgery-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Customized single-stage restoration combining abdominal wall diastasis recti repair, excess skin removal, breast rejuvenation, and waistline contouring.

### Procedure Overview
Pregnancy, childbirth, and breastfeeding create profound, beautiful anatomical changes that diet and rigorous gym exercise often cannot reverse. Stretched abdominal muscles separate (diastasis recti), creating a persistent lower belly pooch; loose, stretched skin forms an overhang; glandular breast tissue deflates and sags; and stubborn fat deposits resist weight loss. A Mommy Makeover is a bespoke, single-stage combination procedure tailored specifically to address these post-pregnancy transformations. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi artfully combines abdominoplasty (tummy tuck with muscle plication), breast rejuvenation (mastopexy lift with or without implants), and VASER 360° waist contouring under a single anesthesia, restoring women’s pre-baby physical form, posture, and self-confidence.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
The primary anatomical defect of pregnancy is diastasis recti—the lateral stretching and separation of the rectus abdominis muscles along the linea alba, which weakens the core and causes lower back pain. In the breast, hormonal involution after lactation results in glandular atrophy and stretched Cooper’s ligaments, causing the nipple-areola complex to descend (ptosis). During a Mommy Makeover, Dr. Gujarathi performs an internal corset repair: the separated abdominal muscles are brought together and sutured in two layers with permanent PDS sutures, instantly narrowing the waist. Concurrently, breast tissue is reshaped and lifted using an inverted-T or lollipop mastopexy, restoring youthful upper-pole fullness with natural projection.

## Advanced Microvascular Surgery in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Super-Microsurgical Free Tissue Transfer, Perforator Flaps & Lymphaticovenular Anastomosis (LVA)
* **Clinical Category:** Super-Microsurgery
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/microvascular-free-flap-surgery-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Tata Memorial Hospital fellowship-trained microvascular anastomosis joining 1–2 mm blood vessels under 20x magnification for limb salvage, head-neck cancer reconstruction, and lymphedema.

### Procedure Overview
Microvascular surgery represents the absolute pinnacle of reconstructive plastic surgery. When extensive tissue loss occurs due to high-energy trauma, severe industrial accidents, or radical oncological resections (such as oral cancer, sarcoma, or breast cancer), conventional skin grafts or local flaps cannot provide adequate coverage. Microvascular free tissue transfer involves disconnecting living vascularized tissue (skin, fat, muscle, or living bone) from a distant donor site, transferring it to the defect, and reconnecting its 1 to 2 mm feeding artery and draining veins under high-power surgical microscopes using stitches finer than human hair. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi, fellowship-trained in Head & Neck and Reconstructive Microsurgery at the prestigious Tata Memorial Hospital, delivers world-class microvascular success rates exceeding 98% across Pune.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Success hinges on deep mastery of microvascular angiosomes and perforator anatomy. Workhorse donor flaps include the Anterolateral Thigh (ALT) perforator flap, the Deep Inferior Epigastric Perforator (DIEP) flap, and the vascularized Free Fibula osteocutaneous flap with peroneal vessels. In the recipient bed (head, neck, or lower leg), recipient arteries such as the facial, superior thyroid, or anterior/posterior tibial arteries are prepared. Under 15x to 25x microscope magnification, 9-0 and 10-0 monofilament nylon sutures are placed through the full thickness of the vessel wall without capturing the back wall, ensuring a smooth, laminar, clot-free endothelial blood flow channel.

## PRP & GFC Biotherapy for Facial Glow & Scars in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Autologous Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) & Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC) Cellular Biotherapy
* **Clinical Category:** Regenerative Medicine
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/prp-gfc-skin-treatment-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** High-concentration autologous growth factors stimulating deep dermal collagen neogenesis, pore refinement, and accelerated acne scar rejuvenation.

### Procedure Overview
Cellular biotherapy uses the body’s own innate regenerative power to halt hair loss, stimulate new hair growth, and restore radiant, youthful skin. Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) and advanced Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC) utilize the concentrated healing proteins stored within your blood platelets—such as Platelet-Derived Growth Factor (PDGF), Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor (VEGF), Epidermal Growth Factor (EGF), and Fibroblast Growth Factor (FGF). When concentrated and micro-injected into thinning scalps or aging skin, these bioactive molecules reactivate dormant hair follicle stem cells, extend the hair growth (anagen) phase, and stimulate fibroblasts to synthesize fresh Type I collagen. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi utilizes medical-grade closed-system centrifugation and painless micro-delivery techniques to deliver clinically proven results with zero synthetic chemicals.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
The hair follicle bulb is richly vascularized and governed by the dermal papilla—the command center of hair growth. In androgenetic alopecia (male and female pattern baldness), dihydrotestosterone (DHT) causes progressive miniaturization of hair follicles, leading to thin, wispy vellus hairs before the follicle ceases production. PRP and GFC micro-injections deliver high concentrations of VEGF directly to the dermal papilla microvascular bed, dramatically increasing local blood supply and reversing follicle miniaturization. For skin rejuvenation (Vampire Facial), platelets injected into the superficial dermis release TGF-beta and EGF, triggering profound neocollagenesis and remodeling acne scars.

## Botox Treatment (Wrinkle Reduction) in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Neuromodulator Chemodenervation for Dynamic Facial Rhytids
* **Clinical Category:** Non-Surgical Aesthetics
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/botox-treatment-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Targeted micro-dosing of authentic US-FDA Allergan Botox smoothing forehead lines, 11-frown creases, and crow’s feet without freezing natural expressions.

### Procedure Overview
Dynamic facial expressions—smiling, frowning, laughing, and squinting—are an essential part of communication. Over time, however, hyperactive contractions of the underlying mimic muscles etch deep creases into the skin, making individuals appear stressed, tired, or older than they feel. Botox (botulinum toxin type A) is the world’s most thoroughly researched non-surgical aesthetic treatment. By precisely relaxing targeted muscle fibers at neuromuscular junctions, dynamic wrinkles soften and disappear while preserving natural, warm facial expressions. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi provides physician-administered Botox treatments using genuine Allergan products, micro-dosing precision, and refined artistic judgment.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
Botox targets the superficial facial musculature: the frontalis (horizontal forehead furrows), procerus and corrugator supercilii (glabellar 11-frown lines), and orbicularis oculi (peri-orbital crow’s feet). Injecting at exact millimetric depths and angles is vital: placing units too low in the forehead can cause brow heaviness, while incorrect glabella placement risks eyelid ptosis. Dr. Gujarathi’s plastic surgery expertise ensures pinpoint anatomical targeting that relaxes only the wrinkles while allowing the brows and eyes to express naturally.

## Dermal Fillers (Facial Volumization) in Pune
* **Medical Nomenclature:** Hyaluronic Acid Dermal Volumization & Structural Facial Scaffolding
* **Clinical Category:** Non-Surgical Aesthetics
* **Canonical URL:** https://drchintangujarathi.com/services/dermal-fillers-treatment-in-pune
* **Clinical Focus:** Physician-administered hyaluronic acid artistry — restoring under-eye tear troughs, cheek projection, nasolabial folds, and lip volume with blunt safety micro-cannulas.

### Procedure Overview
Facial volume loss is one of the earliest and most profound hallmarks of aging. As we age, structural bone resorbs and deep facial fat pads descend, causing hollow under-eye tear troughs, flattened cheekbones, deep smile lines (nasolabial folds), down-turned mouth corners (marionette lines), and thinning lips. Dermal fillers are biocompatible, cross-linked hyaluronic acid (HA) gels that act as natural cushions, restoring youthful 3D architecture, lifting sagging tissues, and smoothing static creases. Dr. Chintan Gujarathi delivers artistic, subtle, and natural facial volumization using premium US-FDA approved fillers (Juvederm, Restylane). Using blunt safety micro-cannulas, filler is delivered smoothly and painlessly with near-zero bruising.

### Anatomical & Surgical Approach
The human face contains complex vascular networks, including the facial, angular, and infraorbital arteries. Delivering fillers safely requires plastic surgical knowledge of the deep fascial planes. Dr. Gujarathi utilizes blunt-tipped micro-cannulas that glide smoothly through subcutaneous tissue planes, pushing blood vessels aside rather than penetrating them. For cheek lifting, high-elasticity (high G-prime) filler is placed directly on the zygomatic periosteum, restoring the face’s structural scaffolding and indirectly softening smile lines without over-plumping the lower face.
